notes.title: Win a limited edition DEXED T-shirt!
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of our new modes Arcade and Zen, we’ve got a competition for you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26408053/9dccde1e65fc2a9862062aed2666c4cc9341ed8a.jpg[/img]

Beat the high score of the Lead Designer of DEXED in [b]normal difficulty Arcade Mode[/b] for the chance to win a limited edition DEXED T-shirt!

[h1][b]High Score to beat: 5,683,165[/b][/h1]

Simply follow @NinjaTheory on Twitter or Facebook, and reply to [url=https://twitter.com/NinjaTheory/status/806511380295745536]this Twitter post[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ninjatheory/posts/1638360989522721:0]this Facebook post[/url] with a screenshot of you beating the high score with #DEXED. If there’s more than one of you, the person who beats it by the most will win.

You have from now until 23.59 GMT on Wednesday the 14th of December. Good luck!

notes.title: New Modes Released, Oculus Rift & Oculus Touch Support
notes.content:
Two new modes are now available for DEXED, completely free!

We have also updated DEXED to fully support Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch, as well as making some minor improvements. The Oculus version will be identical to the Vive version, including the two new modes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_H7s1CK8lwU

[h1][b]Arcade Mode[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26408053/0f2529853e8edb8d2c3656b0a5c18c34fa4348c0.png[/img]

Welcome to the arena. In Arcade Mode, enemies will pour in from all sides. Put your DEXterity and speed truly to the test, shooting down as many as you can whilst chaining massive combos to max out your high score multiplier. Arcade Mode is endless, and will only be over when your life bar depletes to zero.

Protect your life bar by keeping your shields at the ready, and watch out for our dangerous new detonating enemies!

There is of course a global and friends leaderboard for Arcade Mode, where we challenge you to beat our developers’ best scores.


[h1][b]Zen Mode[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26408053/3e5d9ecd86cc86f0234393d36822d457895ed624.png[/img]

Need a break from all the intense shootouts? Look no further than our Zen Mode, where you can sit back, relax, and let us take you on a peaceful tour of each of our beautifully realised worlds. Examine our environments at leisure, completely free from enemies, distractions, and markers. 


[h1][b]Additional Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Automatic camera rotation toggle
[*]General bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New Modes & Oculus Rift Support Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce two brand new modes and full Oculus Rift support coming to DEXED next week!

We took a look at your feedback, and we felt what you requested the most was a new way to advance and share your fire and ice blasting skills, as well as a way to simply enjoy the lush and colourful environments of DEXED with no pressure. As such, we’re very pleased to be bringing you an endless Arcade Mode and Zen Mode.

[h1]Arcade Mode[/h1]
Arcade Mode is an endless mode for the true challengers who want to take their DEXterity to the next level. Battle new enemies, execute seamless combos and challenge players around the world in the leaderboards!

[h1]Zen Mode[/h1]
Zen Mode will take you on a tour of the beautiful environments of DEXED. Sit back and enjoy them at your leisure.  

Check back next week when we’ll be releasing all of this content, and more!
